hardRules.title: Customer-facing only via Chance

hardRules.title: Phones 358-8870 / 8941 / 5628 — no forward
hardRules.detail: Shop lines stay on the desk. Do not forward to cell or AI voice.

companionScript.title: What’s in front of you
companionScript.body: Delco PR-0014 is #1. Soft Ask draft is ready — warm call plus proposal link for Puneet. Fixed $29,807 / Folding $44,232 pretax. Nothing has been sent. AI stays OFF.

companionScript.title: Why it matters tonight
companionScript.body: Competitors (Knapheide + Adrian) are already in play. Stall clock ~48h since inbound. Eleven jobs wait on your GO elsewhere — Delco is still the close that moves first.

companionScript.title: Your call — GO or HOLD
companionScript.body: GO on this deck only queues a stub toast for you — no Wrapstart send, no Gmail, no SMS. Real Soft Ask stays in Wrapstart or your draft when you choose. HOLD parks it safely.

companionScript.title: If they accept
companionScript.body: After accept → 50% deposit invoice on all-in (Fixed ≈ $16,126 / Folding ≈ $23,930). Quotes carry no deposit line. Then Design opens. No free art on a handshake.

companionScript.title: Sales journey walkthrough
companionScript.body: Next we’ll walk the full shop sales journey — inquiry through review — so you can click station-by-station with me. Delco stays #1 on the board; this is the map every job follows. AI OFF · no live send · Soft Ask name stays.

companionScript.title: Journey 1/9 — Inquiry / lead
companionScript.body: Lead just splashed in. We park it — nobody auto-pings the customer. AI stays OFF until you say GO. What we do: Form hits Wrapstart Front Desk. Receptionist captures; Lead Agent stays OFF. Sort wrap / upfit / DekWave into Lead Lake. Customer sees: Thank-you / we got it page only. No Soft Ask yet. No AI chat. Next: Open the lead card · confirm vehicle + scope hints · move to Capture Note: Soft Ask name stays for later outbound — not this step.

companionScript.title: Journey 2/9 — Capture information
companionScript.body: Fill the blanks before we price anything. Photos, fleet size, zip, timeline — junk in means junk quotes. What we do: Human (or practice wallco92) completes intake: vehicle, area, fleet count, zip for tax, timeline, contact. Scrub for Delco/MSA Chance-only tags. Customer sees: Maybe a short clarifying call or form follow-up — only if Chance green-lights. Deck never sends. Next: Mark intake complete · hand packet to Quote Forge

companionScript.title: Journey 3/9 — Get them a quote
companionScript.body: Ballpark becomes a real proposal. Soft Ask tone — full scope beats a cheap partial. Margin Vault checks pretax health + 8.2% all-in tax. What we do: Build ballpark → scrubbed proposal. Margin Guard: C+A tax 8.2%, margin pretax. Thin margin = HOLD for Chance. Delco/MSA never auto-route. Customer sees: Nothing yet. Draft sits behind Chance Gate. Next: Proposal scrub pass · Margin Guard · queue at Chance Gate Note: Draft Soft Ask (call + email) now — send later only when Chance hits real Wrapstart SEND.

companionScript.title: Journey 4/9 — Answer questions
companionScript.body: This is the Soft Ask window. Warm call, proposal link, answer their questions. You alone send anything customer-facing. What we do: Josh Soft Ask outbound if green-lit; Chance owns Delco/MSA. GO/HOLD on this deck = stub toasts only — no Wrapstart, Gmail, or SMS from the deck. Customer sees: Your Soft Ask (when you send from Wrapstart or yourself): kind, clear options, room for questions. No hard close spam. Next: Chance Soft Ask → Mark Sent in Wrapstart · HOLD auto-send · answer inbound Qs Note: Soft Ask = the name. Keep it. One lead, one Soft Ask — no mass blast.

companionScript.title: Journey 5/9 — Create proof / design
companionScript.body: Accept first, then 50% deposit clears Deposit Safe — then Design Studio opens. No free art on a handshake. What we do: After accept → invoice 50% of all-in → Design Studio art/templates → Print Bay when approved. Quotes never carry a deposit line. Customer sees: Deposit invoice, then proofs / mockups for sign-off. Production starts after design OK. Next: Confirm deposit cleared · open Design · customer proof approval · release Print Bay

companionScript.title: Journey 6/9 — Schedule
companionScript.body: Lock the install window once design is signed. Schedule Board owns the calendar — wrap outside / upfit inside stay separate lanes. What we do: Book bay + crew + drop-off/pickup. Confirm vehicle drop time, keys, and any overnight. Hold buffer for materials from Print Bay. Customer sees: Confirm email/text with date, arrival window, what to bring. Still human-sent — not auto from this deck. Next: Pick install slot · confirm with customer · stage materials

companionScript.title: Journey 7/9 — Wait on install
companionScript.body: Install day. Quality over speed. Keep the customer looped on status — happy install = referrals. What we do: Crew runs Install Bay. QC checklist. Photo the finished work. Flag punch-list early, not after they leave. Customer sees: Status updates (human). Pickup walkthrough. Care sheet. Next: QC sign-off · capture finish photos · move to Final payment

companionScript.title: Journey 8/9 — Final payment
companionScript.body: Balance due before keys roll. Deposit Safe already took 50% — Final Pay closes the rest. No awkward chase later. What we do: Invoice remaining balance (all-in). Collect payment. Release vehicle only when paid or Chance-approved terms. Customer sees: Final invoice + receipt. Clear line items. Thank-you note. Next: Collect balance · mark job paid · hand off to Review

companionScript.title: Journey 9/9 — Get review
companionScript.body: Close the loop. Ask for the review while the win is fresh — Google / referral Soft Ask, still Chance-gated if it goes out. What we do: Send review Soft Ask (Chance-approved). Log referral ask. Park photos for future proposals. Update boardSnapshot. Customer sees: Short thank-you + review link. Optional referral ask. Never a blast list. Next: Review Soft Ask out · log stars · mark journey complete Note: Review Soft Ask uses the same Soft Ask name — warm, one customer, Chance SEND if customer-facing.

companionScript.title: Back to Delco #1
companionScript.body: Journey map parked. Delco PR-0014 is still #1 — Soft Ask (call + email) ready, nothing sent, GO/HOLD stubbed on this deck. Flip to BOARD VIEW anytime. AI OFF.

jobs.summary: Amit PR-0026 sent/viewed (~$1,531 all-in). Watch accept → 50% deposit. No resend. Trazer optional later.

thinkPath.label: Proposal scrub

thinkPath.label: Margin Guard PASS
thinkPath.detail: 8.2% all-in tax present. Pretax margin in band. No HOLD flag.

thinkPath.label: Park at Chance Gate
thinkPath.detail: Draft ready. Grok does not send. Josh may nudge Soft Ask only if Chance green-lights.

thinkPath.label: Await Chance SEND
thinkPath.detail: One click from Chance → customer sees it. After accept → deposit → design.

thinkPath.label: Simulate form → Wrapstart

thinkPath.label: Stop before real SEND
